cohort: 320 neonates admitted to the NICU of GB Pant hospital, Srinagar, between January 2020 and June 2020, 58.4% male and 41.6% female.
finding: Respiratory causes accounted for 95.62% of neonatal respiratory distress cases, with TTN (60.9%) and RDS (27.8%) being the most common.
mod_finding: 65% of the neonates were born by cesarean section and 35% by vaginal delivery.
